description: Reference facts for paying and reading on Base mainnet: chain id, native USDC contract and decimals, block explorer and public RPC URLs, and the x402 network identifier. Use to configure an x402 or Base client. Example: only=. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

only.description: Optional: comma-separated top-level result keys to keep, for a smaller answer (for example only=fastestFee,halfHourFee); unknown keys are ignored and an empty match returns the full result

name: network
title: Base network and USDC facts
